Breast Cancer Triage API

Educational FastAPI screening-support demo using the scikit-learn breast-cancer dataset, a reproducible seed-42 training pipeline and DVC-tracked data. Not a medical device. Malignant is target 0 and is the positive class for reported probability.

Release tags: 1.0.0 and latest point to the same production image.

docker run -d --name triage -p 8000:8000 asad3390/breast-cancer-triage-api:1.0.0


Open http://localhost:8000/docs⁠ to send all 30 nonnegative numeric features to POST /predict. Also available: /health, /model/info, /stats. Container port: 8000. Standalone mode does not require Redis.

For Compose, download docker-compose.hub.yml and .env.example from https://github.com/Asadr9671/containerizing-ml-prediction-service-docker-compose-hub-dvc⁠, rename .env.example to .env, then run:

docker compose -f docker-compose.hub.yml up -d --wait


Configuration: MODEL_PATH=artifacts/model.joblib, DECISION_THRESHOLD=0.5, LOG_LEVEL=INFO, optional REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT=6379. Build provenance is exposed through MODEL_VERSION and GIT_SHA. Compose additionally uses DOCKERHUB_USERNAME=asad3390, IMAGE_TAG=1.0.0, and API_PORT=8000. Redis counts successful predictions; inference continues during Redis outages. The image runs as non-root UID 10001 and includes a /health healthcheck.

Breast Cancer Triage API

Educational FastAPI screening-support demo using the scikit-learn breast-cancer dataset, a reproducible seed-42 training pipeline and DVC-tracked data. Not a medical device. Malignant is target 0 and is the positive class for reported probability.

Release tags: 1.0.0 and latest point to the same production image.

docker run -d --name triage -p 8000:8000 asad3390/breast-cancer-triage-api:1.0.0


Open http://localhost:8000/docs⁠ to send all 30 nonnegative numeric features to POST /predict. Also available: /health, /model/info, /stats. Container port: 8000. Standalone mode does not require Redis.

For Compose, download docker-compose.hub.yml and .env.example from https://github.com/Asadr9671/containerizing-ml-prediction-service-docker-compose-hub-dvc⁠, rename .env.example to .env, then run:

docker compose -f docker-compose.hub.yml up -d --wait


Configuration: MODEL_PATH=artifacts/model.joblib, DECISION_THRESHOLD=0.5, LOG_LEVEL=INFO, optional REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT=6379. Build provenance is exposed through MODEL_VERSION and GIT_SHA. Compose additionally uses DOCKERHUB_USERNAME=asad3390, IMAGE_TAG=1.0.0, and API_PORT=8000. Redis counts successful predictions; inference continues during Redis outages. The image runs as non-root UID 10001 and includes a /health healthcheck.
